settings.description: Where does the count-vs-precision optimum sit as the budget moves? The same six precision families (luma 3/4/5/6 bits x chroma 3/4 bits), each filled to the same byte target with as many coefficients as fit, at 16/21/24/48/80 B. The shipped format holds precision constant across its whole tier range; this asks whether that is true of the R-D optimum. Every arm pins the four selection/encoder knobs to their PRE-adoption values so the comparison isolates the layout: §10 adopted aniso=1.2, sel_hv=0.15, scale_fit=2 and ac_nearest=1 as defaults, and an arm that omitted them would silently carry the adopted recipe — which had made the incumbent identical to the L28@4 C15@3 arm it was meant to be measured against.
